heroHeading: Connected to India's Premier Textile Sourcing Hubs
heroSummary: Shree Durga Agency bridges buyers directly with specialized production clusters across India. Rather than single-source limitations, our network accesses the distinct craft, weaving, and manufacturing strengths of each regional market.

keyPillars.title: Surat Sourcing Hub
keyPillars.description: The nation's capital for synthetic sarees, georgette, chiffon, digital prints, and high-volume jacquards with unbeatable turnarounds.
keyPillars.targetYear: Daily direct access to master weavers and dye mills
initiatives: Extensive print collections updated weekly with trending catalog designs
Direct manufacturer pricing for bulk retail and wholesale distribution
Strict on-site fabric weight (GSM) and colorfastness checking before packing

keyPillars.title: Varanasi Heritage Cluster
keyPillars.description: Authentic handloom and powerloom Banarasi sarees, brocades, bridal dupattas, and intricate zari masterworks direct from artisan looms.
keyPillars.targetYear: Curated collections for bridal and festive retail showrooms
initiatives: Direct coordination with generational master weavers and karkhanas
Authenticity verification for pure silk, blend counts, and genuine zari motifs
Exclusive bridal custom color runs and matching lehenga fabric coordination

keyPillars.title: Jaipur & Sanganer Hub
keyPillars.description: Renowned for handcrafted block prints, Bagru natural dyes, pure mulmul cotton suit sets, and vibrant Rajasthani ethnic wear.
keyPillars.targetYear: Sourcing partner for premium boutiques and D2C brands
initiatives: Hand-block printing units adhering to traditional vegetable and eco-dye processes
Ready-to-stitch suits, kurtis, and running fabric roll sourcing
Pre-shrinkage and bleed testing before wholesale shipment dispatch

keyPillars.title: Delhi, Kolkata & Panipat Markets
keyPillars.description: Delhi wholesale apparel & fancy borders, Kolkata traditional Jamdani & cotton drapes, and Panipat specialized home textiles.
keyPillars.targetYear: Unified multi-market consolidation under single shipment
initiatives: Chandni Chowk and Gandhi Nagar wholesale consolidation for trend items
Bengal handloom cotton and linen saree curation direct from artisan hubs
Consolidated billing and logistics coordination across multi-city suppliers

waterStewardship.summary: We coordinate multi-city sourcing schedules, supplier vetting, and doorstep logistics so your business accesses genuine factory rates with complete peace of mind.
